main.name: Back Squat
main.cue: Brace hard, sit between the hips, drive up through midfoot.

main.name: Front Squat
main.cue: Elbows high, chest tall, stay upright.

main.name: Bench Press
main.cue: Set the rack safeties. Shoulder blades pinned, bar to lower chest.

main.name: Incline Bench Press
main.cue: Bench around 30 degrees. This is your upper-chest builder.

main.name: Floor Press
main.cue: Let the elbows touch the floor and pause each rep.

main.name: Overhead Press
main.cue: Squeeze the glutes, press, then push your head through.

main.name: Push Press
main.cue: Short dip with the legs, then punch the bar overhead.

main.name: Deadlift
main.cue: Bar over midfoot, pull the slack out, push the floor away.

accessories.name: Romanian Deadlift
accessories.cue: Soft knees, push the hips back until the hamstrings load.

accessories.name: KB Single-Leg RDL
accessories.cue: Keep the hips square and reach the bell toward the floor.

accessories.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
accessories.cue: Upper back on the bench, pause at the top.

accessories.name: Heavy KB Swing
accessories.cue: Hike the bell back, snap the hips, float it to chest height.

accessories.name: Good Morning
accessories.cue: Light bar. Flat back, hips back, stand tall.

accessories.name: DB Split Squat
accessories.cue: Back knee drops straight down, front heel stays planted.

accessories.name: KB Goblet Squat
accessories.cue: Bell at the chest, elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

accessories.name: DB Step-Up
accessories.cue: Drive through the top foot. No push from the back leg.

accessories.name: DB Walking Lunge
accessories.cue: Long steps, torso tall.

accessories.name: DB Bulgarian Split Squat
accessories.cue: Rear foot on the bench. Slow on the way down.

accessories.name: Goblet Reverse Lunge
accessories.cue: Step back softly, knee kisses the floor.

accessories.name: Plank
accessories.cue: Squeeze glutes and quads. Ribs down.

accessories.name: Dead Bug
accessories.cue: Low back glued to the floor.

accessories.name: Hollow Hold
accessories.cue: Arms overhead, shoulders and feet just off the floor.

accessories.name: Side Plank
accessories.cue: Straight line from head to heels.

accessories.name: KB Suitcase Carry
accessories.cue: Heavy bell in one hand. Do not lean.

accessories.name: Bear Crawl
accessories.cue: Knees an inch off the ground, back flat.

accessories.name: DB Lateral Raise
accessories.cue: Lead with the elbows and stop at shoulder height.

accessories.name: DB Arnold Press
accessories.cue: Rotate palms out as you press.

accessories.name: DB Rear Delt Fly
accessories.cue: Hinge over, sweep the bells wide. Light and strict.

accessories.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
accessories.cue: Bench upright, press without arching.

accessories.name: KB Bottoms-Up Press
accessories.cue: Grip hard and keep the bell balanced upside down.

accessories.name: Push-Up
accessories.cue: Body in one line, chest to the floor.

accessories.name: DB Incline Press
accessories.cue: Low incline, full stretch at the bottom.

accessories.name: DB Fly
accessories.cue: Slight bend in the elbows, big stretch, squeeze at the top.

accessories.name: DB Floor Press
accessories.cue: Pause the elbows on the floor.

accessories.name: Deficit Push-Up
accessories.cue: Hands on dumbbells, sink below them.

accessories.name: DB Curl
accessories.cue: Elbows pinned, turn the pinkies up at the top.

accessories.name: DB Hammer Curl
accessories.cue: Neutral grip, no swinging.

accessories.name: Barbell Curl
accessories.cue: Strict. Stop before the elbows drift forward.

accessories.name: DB Incline Curl
accessories.cue: Arms hang behind you for a long stretch.

accessories.name: DB Overhead Triceps Extension
accessories.cue: Elbows point up, deep stretch behind the head.

accessories.name: DB Skull Crusher
accessories.cue: Lower to the sides of the head, elbows still.

accessories.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
accessories.cue: Hands under the shoulders, elbows brush the ribs.

accessories.name: DB Triceps Kickback
accessories.cue: Upper arm parallel to the floor, lock out and squeeze.

accessories.name: Barbell Row
accessories.cue: Hinge to about 45 degrees, pull to the belly button.

accessories.name: One-Arm DB Row
accessories.cue: Pull the elbow to the hip pocket.

accessories.name: Pendlay Row
accessories.cue: Bar from the floor each rep, back flat.

accessories.name: KB Gorilla Row
accessories.cue: Wide stance, alternate arms, no twisting.

accessories.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
accessories.cue: Chest on an incline bench, squeeze the shoulder blades.

accessories.name: Renegade Row
accessories.cue: Plank on the dumbbells, row without rotating.

accessories.name: DB Thruster
accessories.cue: Front squat straight into a press, one smooth motion.

accessories.name: KB Clean & Press
accessories.cue: Clean to the rack, then press.

accessories.name: DB Squat to Press
accessories.cue: Squat deep, stand and press.

accessories.name: KB Swing
accessories.cue: Snap the hips, arms are just ropes.

accessories.name: Burpee
accessories.cue: Chest to the floor, jump at the top.
